headline.text: L2 FFS web tracking failed — line was down *most of 24 hours*, still unresolved at window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel cluster and pecan products with several small issues resolved inside the window — metal found in pecans prompted a lot change, IMS ran out of thermal ribbon overnight but L2 supplied a replacement, and a chiller compressor reset cleared a glycol temperature alarm. Cardboard bailer remains locked out while waiting on replacement safety sensors.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 FFS was down most of the day fighting web tracking and film alignment issues — maintenance worked with Syntegon support but could not get the sensors calibrated by window close, with Monday startup planned. ML2 ran moulded bars without major incident after a belt trim.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 ran through multiple quality flags — bottom shell thickness out of spec due to high depositor weights, defective flow wrap rolls, and 281 pounds of truffle scrap from an 80g weight miss. ML1 was down several hours for a depositor gasket replacement and shut-off rack alignment, back online by 10:00.

resolved.title: S3 thermal ribbon out, line stopped for labels
resolved.summary: Matrix packing lines could not print labels because IMS ran out of thermal ribbon, halting production overnight.
resolved.resolution: Ribbon sourced from L2, line running again by 05:16 (Luis Falcon).

resolved.title: Metal detection hit in pecans
resolved.summary: Metal found in pecan lot during production — Jorel requested immediate lot change to avoid hitting the 3-strike rule and shutting down the line.
resolved.resolution: New lot mixed in by 14:18, hold placed on affected pecan lot (Charity Young).

resolved.title: S3 chiller 2nd compressor not starting
resolved.summary: Glycol temperature rising on Tunnel 2 because the second chiller compressor failed to turn on, triggering air temperature alarms on the enrober.
resolved.resolution: Compressors reset at 16:57, glycol temperature dropping, product unaffected (William Beattie).

resolved.title: S1 MM9 belt tension low after CILT
resolved.summary: After performing clean-in-place on MM9 and cross conveyor, operators noticed belt tension needed adjustment before restarting.
resolved.resolution: Caleb York added tension, line restarted at 19:55.

resolved.title: S1 MM9 infeed conveyor not running
resolved.summary: Infeed conveyor for MM9 stopped running due to a cover interlock message on the screen.
resolved.resolution: Covers put back down, belt running again (Caleb York, 17:55).

resolved.title: ML2 belt after 90° tearing badly
resolved.summary: Belt downstream of the 90-degree turn started tearing and needed replacement or repair to avoid failure.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance trimmed the belt by 13:15 (Alex Mendoza, Hervin Herrera).

resolved.title: Peco pallet inventory inaccurate in RF Smart
resolved.summary: RF Smart showed Hershey Peco pallets transferred to L1/L3 when 750 were physically at L2, blocking VFFS from staging the 150 needed.

resolved.title: Truffle M3 conveyor belt moving laterally
resolved.summary: M3 conveyor belt was tracking side to side, causing positioning issues at flow wrap.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance corrected by 16:32, belt running properly.

resolved.title: Truffle M3 conveyor belt moving again overnight
resolved.summary: Same M3 conveyor belt issue recurred on third shift.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 3 cream weight high at startup
resolved.summary: Cream capture test came back at top of spec range (high weights contribute to thin bottom shells and bad backs on bars).
resolved.resolution: Retest at 07:56 showed cream in range; cream barrels from earlier operator error placed on hold with LPNs (Preston Tregaskis, 09:42).

resolved.title: ML4 operator forgot to turn on cream depositor
resolved.summary: Operator completed capture test but forgot to turn the power button back on — depositor stopped mid-run, creating 4 molds of defective bars.
resolved.resolution: Four molds marked bad, bars manually rejected by EEs stationed at de-mold, operator coached (Rich Brierley, 08:06).

resolved.title: ML4 tape machine roller rubber broken
resolved.summary: Tape machine at case packing stopped working properly when the roller rubber broke.
resolved.resolution: Borrowed roller from MFM, replaced by 09:35 (ML4 WDS).

needs_attention.title: S3 color variations — 180 trays on hold
needs_attention.summary: Pecan clusters showing streaking and white spots inconsistent enough that uniform palletizing was not possible.
needs_attention.status: 180 trays on hold as of 22:02. Next shift informed to continue sorting as same defects appearing.

needs_attention.title: Cardboard bailer locked out, safety sensors bad
needs_attention.summary: Maintenance locked out the cardboard bailer because safety sensors failed and no replacement parts are in stock.
needs_attention.status: Workaround in place: stacking cardboard on pallets for IP trailer pickup. William Lopez ordered replacement sensors as of 09:04.

needs_attention.title: Internet outage across L1
needs_attention.summary: Plant-wide internet connectivity lost, forcing IMS team and Nathan Topham to work off phone hotspots.
needs_attention.status: Nathan emailing tech support as of 07:12. No resolution posted in window.

needs_attention.title: FFS web tracking sensor failure
needs_attention.summary: Film web sensor could not be calibrated — tracking drifted out of range repeatedly throughout first and second shift, causing line stoppages and preventing consistent pouch production.
needs_attention.status: Line down at end of third shift (05:21). Raymond Fleming attempted recalibration 3 times overnight without success. Alan Todd requested Syntegon support and maintenance on-site Monday morning for startup.

needs_attention.title: ML2 no lid cover for depositor
needs_attention.summary: Depositor missing protective lid cover at end of second shift.

needs_attention.title: Almond residue in panning machine
needs_attention.summary: Visual inspection at start of second shift found almond residue inside the panning/sorting machine after cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Failed visual inspection posted at 21:56. No re-clean or follow-up posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 depositor down for gasket and shut-off rack
needs_attention.summary: ML1 was down from early first shift through mid-morning — chocolate leaked from depositor front during piston test, gasket found out of position, and shut-off rack switch 2 was stiff and not sliding correctly.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance adjusted shut-off rack, new gasket installed and ATP passed by 09:35. Line running properly by 10:17 (Grey Boscan).

needs_attention.title: Truffle bites underweight, 281 lbs scrap
needs_attention.summary: Truffle bite weights came out at 80g instead of 88-90g spec — too low to adjust, entire batch scrapped.
needs_attention.status: 281 pounds of chocolate scrap recorded at 23:02. No root cause or corrective action posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 bottom shell thickness out of spec
needs_attention.summary: Bottom chocolate shell measured 1.25mm average versus 1.5mm minimum — Preston Tregaskis attributed this to cream and caramel depositor weights running at top of spec.
needs_attention.status: One later check at 09:46 showed 2.09mm (in spec), but Preston requested continued monitoring every 30 minutes through flagged mold population. Still monitoring as of 08:41.

needs_attention.title: Defective flow wrap with silvering
needs_attention.summary: Two rolls of flow wrap from first shift yesterday had silvering around the lettering — QA flagged them. Today three more unlabeled rolls found with same defect.
needs_attention.status: Angel Cabrera instructed Daniel McCarty to work with IMS to create new total-quantity label and complete hold disposition through NetSuite. Pallet to be moved to hold area by aisle one (10:07).

needs_attention.title: L3 back door not locking
needs_attention.summary: Rear exterior door in L3 will not lock, creating a security and climate-control risk.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 22:58. No maintenance response posted in window.
